{"metadata":{"description":"Automatic ghost suggestions and one-click next-message drafting for the DeepSeek Harness composer.","id":"gh:1335689561","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"prompt-for-me","slug":"ChuanTianML/prompt-for-me","topics":["ai-coding","deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh-plugin","productivity","prompt-engineering"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Automatic ghost suggestions and one-click next-message drafting for the DeepSeek Harness composer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Prompt for Me"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-for-me) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-for-"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"me) [](https://github.com/ChuanTianML/prompt-for-me)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Prompt for Me prepares your next message in the DeepSeek Harness composer. After the agent replies, "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"you can accept a suggestion, edit it, or generate another. The plugin helps you draft; you decide wh"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ept a suggestion, edit it, or generate another. The plugin helps you draft; you decide when to send."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## See it in action"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**1. Your next message, ready after the reply**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"When the composer is idle, a suggestion appears in light gray. It is not part of your draft yet, and"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" nothing is sent automatically."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**2. Accept it, then make it yours**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Press **Tab** or click **✓** to turn the suggestion into editable text. Here, we add “Keep it under "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"eight words.” You still decide when to send."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**3. Want another direction? Click the sparkles**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Click **✦**, immediately left of Send, or use the default shortcut **⌘⇧Space / Ctrl+Shift+Space**. A"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" fresh next message goes straight into the draft for you to review or edit."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"*Real product screenshots using a fictional project and demo conversations. Private session lists, w"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"orkspace information, and runtime statistics are outside the captured area.*"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Generates only after a newly completed turn when the session is idle, plan mode is inactive, and t"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"he composer has exactly empty text, no images, and no queued intent.
- Retains that completed turn w"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"hile Host policy loads or the composer is temporarily ineligible, then generates once the requiremen"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ts are met.
- Cancels an in-flight automatic request if the composer becomes ineligible; late result"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"s cannot restore the suggestion. An explicit rejection by the native composer does not open a fallba"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ck preview.
- Retires suggestions from the preceding context when a newer turn completes, including "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"after submissions that settle too quickly for an intermediate composer state to render.
- Shows nati"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ve inline ghost text on compatible Harness clients. Older clients use a small preview card without m"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"utating the draft.
- Accepts a ghost with Tab, Right Arrow, or the adjacent check control. Enter nev"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"er accepts ghost text.
- Hides the ghost when you type, offers it again if you clear the draft, and "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"dismisses it with Escape.
- Keeps the Sparkles Trigger and `Mod+Shift+Space` shortcut. An explicit T"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"rigger always requests a fresh suggestion and writes it directly into the draft, even while automati"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"c generation is in flight.
- Sends skipped suggestions with the next explicit request so the model a"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"voids repeating or paraphrasing them. The bounded cycle stores at most ten.
- Never bypasses Harness"},{"id":"p15s15","text":" approvals, never invokes tools, and never sends a message automatically."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Interaction reference"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Situation | Result |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| A turn completes and the composer is eligible | One automatic suggestion appears outside the draft"},{"id":"p18s2","text":". |
| Tab, Right Arrow, or the check control | The visible suggestion becomes one undoable draft edi"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"t. |
| Enter while only a ghost is visible | Nothing is accepted or sent. |
| Start typing | The gho"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"st hides; your text wins. |
| Clear the typed text | The hidden suggestion can reappear without anot"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"her model call. |
| Escape | The visible suggestion is dismissed. |
| Sparkles button or `Mod+Shift+"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"Space` | A fresh suggestion is generated and directly fills or replaces the draft. |
| Edit and Ente"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"r | Only the final text is submitted; adoption becomes positive feedback only now. |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The release tarball is the simplest option because it contains prebuilt Host and Client artifacts:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` after installation."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"You may also install a pinned Git tag:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Version 0.6.2 fixes a startup failure when this plugin and another plugin, such as dshmarket, load S"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"chemastery concurrently. Upgrade affected 0.6.0/0.6.1 installations with `dsh plugin --profile web a"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"dd dsh-prompt-for-me@0.6.2`, then restart DSH."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Data and privacy"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"On each automatic or explicit generation request, the Host may send these bounded text fields to the"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" selected model provider:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- the current draft;
- the last three direct-human/assistant turns from the current session;
- curre"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nt-session submitted suggestion edits, exact accepts, and rejected suggestions;
- bounded raw exampl"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"es from manual prompts and suggestion interactions in up to 20 earlier sessions;
- up to ten suggest"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ions skipped during the current cycle, so the model can avoid repeating or paraphrasing them."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The current draft and recent turns determine the task, intent, and message content. Current-session "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"feedback adjusts the immediate wording. Cross-session memory may influence only durable style, detai"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"l, and workflow preferences. Manual prompts and submitted suggestion edits carry more weight than ex"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"act accepts; rejected suggestions are weak negative evidence. Editing a suggestion and triggering ag"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ain rejects the original suggestion but does not treat the unsubmitted edit as a positive preference"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"in rejects the original suggestion but does not treat the unsubmitted edit as a positive preference."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Harness records injected workspace instructions, runtime context, and skill catalogs in user-role ev"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ents. The plugin excludes these non-human sources from conversation turns and preference memory. If "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"both the draft and direct-human conversation are empty, generation stops before the model call."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Common API-key, token, password, and Bearer-token patterns are replaced with `[REDACTED_SECRET]` bef"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ore the model call. Attachments, tool arguments, files, credentials, and binary blocks are not colle"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"cted. The plugin has no analytics endpoint and sends data only to the model route already selected i"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"plugin has no analytics endpoint and sends data only to the model route already selected in Harness."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Interaction records are stored only in this browser's `localStorage` under `dsh.prompt-for-me.outcom"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"es.v2`. Each record contains its session ID, final action, origin, and the relevant original/final t"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ext. Merely seeing or adopting ghost text is not positive feedback; it becomes evidence only after s"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ubmission. Version 1 records migrate automatically and remain untouched. The plugin does not expose "},{"id":"p33s5","text":"a reset control that asks users to manage this history."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
